snippet.title: CloudPaws - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for CloudPaws, an adventure trading exploration simulation game developed by MFG. Players will take to the skies as a feline protagonist to pilot a flying shop across the Cloud Archipelago. Meet unique characters, complete requests and special deliveries, and discover new locations beyond the horizon. CloudPaws is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#CloudPaws #Gaming #IGN
